note: Routing smoke scenarios. Every skill is model-invocable; expect names the skill the model should route each matching prompt to, and 'none' marks a genuine non-match. Later packages append their skills' scenarios here.

scenarios.prompt: I changed a codeunit and its tests. Run the full gate before we move on.
Set up the AL toolchain for this repo: compiler channels, symbols, analyzers, breaking-change baseline.
Draw what we just landed as a picture the PM can steer from, on the side panel.
Clone Microsoft's Base App source locally so I can read how posting routines are implemented.
Refresh the BC quality knowledge base clone and rebuild its knowledge index.
I have a rough plan for a new feature. Stress-test my thinking — interview me until we both understand it.
This release announcement reads like a chatbot wrote it. Cut the AI tells and give it a human voice.
Put my design through a relentless interview before I commit to it.
scenarios.note: al-grill-me delegates to al-grilling; the routing result should be the interview engine

scenarios.prompt: Wait, I don't understand where you've got to. Explain that last message again in plain language.
Mine my session history for recurring AL mistakes and propose standing lessons.
What did I work on yesterday?
scenarios.note: The chronicle standup owns this generic history question; al-miner handles explicit lesson mining.

scenarios.prompt: Add a standing lesson line so I stop repeating this container mistake in future sessions.
Does Modify(false) skip the OnModify trigger? Check before I write this.
Show me how the Base App implements posting preview for a journal.
Research which BC shape fits this whole feature and write a cited report with diagrams.
scenarios.note: The native /research command owns this broad research request; al-lookup handles one platform question or precedent.

scenarios.prompt: Implement the next frontier bullet — its failing-test spec is already on it.
Reshape this working code without changing its behavior.
Review my diff since main against what the bullet asked — standards and spec side by side.
What could this small change break beyond the files it touches?
scenarios.note: Blast-radius review requests belong to al-review.

scenarios.prompt: The bullet just landed — run the loop transition: show the delta, reconcile the design, sharpen what's next.
Draw the objects and event flows this branch changed, as boxes and connections.
What's next on my plate?
scenarios.note: A generic next-step question should not trigger al-next; the transition needs a landed bullet.

scenarios.prompt: Architect this feature in BC shapes — is it master data with entries, or a document flavor?
Model who publishes and who subscribes when posting completes.
Cut the settled design into tracer-bullet work items with blocking edges.
My PR is ready — watch CI and the Copilot review, fix the findings, keep it synced with main until it can merge.
Merge main into my PR branch and sort out the object-number collisions.
Run the whole loop on the next ready bullet — implement, reshape if needed, review — and pause only where a decision needs me.
I have a fresh feature idea for our BC app — interview me until the vocabulary is unambiguous.
Two teams use 'batch' to mean different things in this app — settle the term and record it.
The gate is green — clean this up before we move on.
The slice is green — walk it in the web client and show me it works.
Let's do a walkthrough of the template export before I demo it to the customer.
